EditTextPreference.android:title: Emby Server URL
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Use an https address, e.g. https://emby.example.com (plain http is blocked)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Alert me when someone reaches a limit
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Keeps a small connection to your server open in the background and shows a notification with +15/+30/+60 buttons. Uses a little battery; some phones need the app excluded from battery optimisation for this to stay on.
